context: Interface first on SSB only. Keep top-level benchbox.SSB facade. Measure, then implement, then remasure. No other family in this item.
description:
BLOCKED on arch-composition-boundary-adr (seam gate 3: core API files free of concrete adapter imports depends on the composition decision).

Do NOT pilot JoinOrder. Canonical JoinOrder is pinned to scale 1.0, 30-90 minutes, ~5 GB, 1.2 GB download, unresolved IMDb/Dataverse licensing (DATA-LICENSE.md), and has no cheap end-to-end CI path. It cannot produce the before/after extension-cost measurement this item exists to take.

Do NOT pilot TPC-DS (streams + compliance). TPC-H is runnable at 0.01 but has supports_streams: true — the complexity the seam README used to reject TPC-DS.

Pilot SSB:
- support_status: stable
- scale_options include 0.01; estimated 1-5 minutes; data_source: null (synthetic)
- supports_streams: false
- supports_dataframe: true with dataframe_queries/ package
- already CI-gated via make ssb-cross-surface-equivalence-report

Extension-cost metric (not file count): semantic decisions, repeated code, new tests, UAT/CI minutes, elapsed contributor time. Measure before (current cost to add a hypothetical SSB-like family) and after the seam.

Non-goals from the seam README: no third base class; no making benchmark_loader public; no moving all of benchbox/core/<benchmark>/; no result-bundle shape change.

Stop condition: SSB implements the small registry-backed family interface; before/after cost table is in the PR; wrapper facade tests still green; make ssb-cross-surface-equivalence-report still PASS.

anti_patterns.dont: move all of benchbox/core into family packages
anti_patterns.why: seam README forbids a mechanical core split
JoinOrder cannot be measured cheaply; TPC-DS streams obscure the seam

anti_patterns.dont: use file count as the success metric
anti_patterns.why: fewer files can hide a monolith

preserves.behavior: No other benchmark family is moved onto the seam in this item
SSB at scale 0.01 still runs on DuckDB SQL and DataFrame
